profile.summaryJa: この節では低地のオリーブといちじく桑の木をバアル・ハナンが管理し、油の貯蔵所はヨアシュの担当とされています。

sources.title: World English Bible · 1CH 27:28
sources.attribution: World English Bible (WEB), public domain; fixed local witness webp-usfx-2026-10-13-35a6adf626e5.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the lowland was Baal Hanan the Gederite. Over the cellars of oil was Joash.
